chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
E minor with a bright Dorian lift to G major
fast driving pulse-wave lead with a pushed syncopated eighth-note hook
galloping plucked sampled bass in octaves
sampled 16-bit drum kit: driving snare backbeat and tom fills, a light kick on beats one and three, crash cymbals on phrase starts
rapid harp arpeggios like spinning wheel spokes
bright glass bell glints flashing past
reckless, exhilarating downhill race at night, wind in your face
seamless transition back to the theme
